difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts the commutativity of a square of derived functors: pulling back the derived tensor product agrees with the derived tensor product of the pullbacks (statement lines 3848-3875, whose displayed Xy-pic diagram is delivered verbatim). The proof uses the existence of K-flat resolutions with flat terms to reduce the comparison to complexes on which both the pullback and the tensor product are computed naively (proof lines 3877-3890), where the two paths give the same total complex, and then transfers the conclusion to arbitrary complexes because the chosen representatives compute the derived functors (proof lines 3890-3910). The non-formal content is the choice of representatives that makes both paths computable. The claim is H2: one representative choice plus one comparison of total complexes.
